title: Missile fields as the obvious place for the watchers
place_text: Missile fields of South Dakota and Montana, USA

tellings.quote: then missile fields in South Dakota in Montana are not a strange place to find them at all. They are the obvious place.

plain: If something non-human has been watching humanity's most powerful weapons since the end of the Second World War, then the nuclear missile fields of South Dakota and Montana are "not a strange place to find them at all. They are the obvious place." Michels puts this forward himself, as his own framing, in an episode where Air Force veterans who say they were abducted by aliens meet again fifty years later. If he is right, sightings around missile bases would be watchers checking on our weapons, not chance.
